task: When should we schedule maintenance on the charging stations in the Bolzano area to minimise impact on users? Propose concrete weekday/time windows backed by observed usage.
markdown:
## Answer
The best maintenance window in the Bolzano area is early morning, 05:00-07:00 local time, on Tuesday to Friday, with Thursday the strongest candidate. Thu 05:00-07:00 shows occupancy of 6.6%, against 43.5% overall [E2]. These windows rest on only 4-5 comparable dates each, so treat them as well-supported but not certain [E2].

## Key findings
- Lowest-usage 2-hour windows: Thu 05:00-07:00 at 6.6% (5 dates), Tue 05:00-07:00 at 12.4% (4 dates) and Fri 05:00-07:00 at 14.6% (4 dates) [E2].
- Usage rises sharply after 07:00: Wed is 41.2% at 07:00 and 63.6% at 08:00, and Thu is 66.1% at 08:00 [E2].
- Weekday daytime from 08:00 to 19:00 mostly runs at roughly 37-66%, so daytime work would affect more users [E2].
- Avoid the busiest windows: Wed 20:00-22:00 at 72.0%, Sat 21:00-23:00 at 65.4% and Mon 20:00-22:00 at 65.1% [E2].
- Weekend nights are not quiet: Sat 02:00 is 82.1%, Sat 23:00 is 98.4% and Fri 23:00 is 93.8% [E2].
- Sun 21:00-23:00 is low (0.9% at 21:00, 6.7% at 22:00), but Sun 20:00 is 63.5%, so this is only a secondary option with less support [E2].
- Busiest sites: BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (66.9% occupancy, 203 starts, peak hour 08:00), BZ_P_VITTORIA (63.5%, 135 starts, peak hour 08:00) and BZ_BOEHLER_01 (57.0%, 170 starts, peak hour 05:00) [E3].

## Recommendation
Schedule routine maintenance on Thursday 05:00-07:00, using Tuesday and Friday 05:00-07:00 as backups [E2]. Finish before 07:00, because usage climbs quickly after that [E2]. For BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 and BZ_P_VITTORIA, whose peak is 08:00, the early window should work well, but finish by 07:00 [E3]. BZ_BOEHLER_01 peaks at 05:00, so check its own hourly profile before using this window there [E3]. Keep Friday and Saturday late evenings and nights free of planned work [E2].

## Limitations & unknowns
- The lowest windows rest on only 4-5 comparable dates, and 44 grid cells fall below the 4-date minimum [E2].
- Null night cells mean unknown, not zero. Some 0.0 values at 00:00-05:00 may reflect little observable data, so a night window is not proven quiet [E2].
- The top three sites have low coverage: 14.7%, 8.2% and 22.7% [E3].
- 22 sites were excluded for exposure under 24 h, and only 43 of 51 sites have data in the window [E1, E3].
- The Bolzano area is a context bounding box, not the municipal boundary [E1].
- Occupancy is not demand, energy, sessions or faults. No stale-flag or per-site data-quality check was run [E1, E2].

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status (echarging-plug-status-ocpi), window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] hourly_profile(scope=bolzano) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=occupancy, area=bolzano) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14

- **Key caveat:** The 6.6% Thursday figure rests on 5 dates, and early-morning occupancy may be understated because null or 0.0 night cells mean "no data", not "quiet". Confirm with per-site data before committing.
